title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs Desk Note: Prior Authorization Renewal Allowance on the Manufacturer Copay Card
content:
A renewal allowance is added to the Manufacturer Copay Card counter benefit of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs. It follows the latest prior authorization approval on file for the card's prescription under Prescription Insurance on File: an approval dated **on or after the first day of the current benefit period** adds **100.00 dollars**, an **earlier** approval adds **50.00 dollars**, and **no approval** adds nothing. It is added after the counter minimum pay is taken off and before the counter benefit is held to the benefit dollars left on the program.

The first day of the current benefit period is the one the card enrollment shows; only the latest approval on file for the prescription is looked at.

| Latest prior authorization approval for the card's prescription | Renewal allowance |
|---|---|
| Dated on the period's first day or later | $100.00 |
| Dated before the period's first day | $50.00 |
| None on file | $0.00 |

*Hypothetical:* with a current period starting January 1, an approval dated January 1 adds $100.00, and one dated the previous December 31 adds $50.00.
